card.name: Mayim Mayim
card.tagline: Circle dance of joy at finding water in the desert
card.profile: Mayim Mayim ('water, water') is an Israeli folk circle dance. Per Wikipedia, the dance was created in 1937 for a festival to celebrate the discovery of water in Kibbutz Naan after a seven-year search; the choreographer was Else I. Dublon. The music was composed by Emanuel Amiran (Pugashov) and the lyrics taken from Isaiah 12:3 ('Joyfully shall you draw water from the wells of salvation') (Wikipedia, Mayim Mayim). It is danced in a circle facing center, hands held except when clapping; its first four counts - the 'Mayim step' - are a grapevine/cherkessia step that became known to Israelis through this dance.
card.insight: Mayim Mayim has spread far beyond Israel - it became a fixture of Japanese school physical-education classes after being introduced during the post-war American occupation - and is often performed at international folk dance events (Wikipedia; Unseen Japan).
